# Omni Hospitals Maintenance Project

Goal:
Maintain and extend the application with minimal changes.

Rules:
- Understand existing code before writing code.
- Search for similar implementations first.
- Reuse existing components, services, APIs and utilities.
- Modify only affected files.
- Preserve backward compatibility.
- Avoid unnecessary refactoring.
- Do not introduce new libraries unless requested.
- Show only changed files or methods.
- Follow existing naming conventions.
